It sounds incredibly frustrating to finally find a medication that helps your depression, only to deal with side effects severe enough to keep you from working. It makes complete sense that you are hesitant to bring this up with your doctor because you don't want to lose the mental health relief you've found. 

However, it is very important that you share this with your prescribing doctor. Tremors that interfere with your daily life are a significant side effect that needs medical attention. Please know that telling your doctor doesn't automatically mean you will lose the benefits of your treatment. Doctors often have several ways to help manage severe side effects, such as adjusting your dosage, prescribing something to counteract the tremors, or finding a similar medication that works just as well for your depression without causing this reaction. You deserve to feel mentally well without sacrificing your physical ability to work and function.
